purpose: Test whether causal physical reachability plus a coherent block-partially-exchangeable temporal likelihood supplies safe incremental source evidence over PMFS without adding a third scientific module.

preserved_negative_dependencies.v2_failure_used_for_revision: per-stop nuisance-member switching and within-block pseudo-replication were falsified; the V2 carrier-to-cell projection remains unchanged

scientific_modules.M1_causal_physical_operator: native GADEN do(S=s) physical concentration followed by the frozen run-persistent sensor operator and a reached/not-reached event over the first 80 samples of each completed stop
scientific_modules.M2_CBPE_temporal_operator: three newly completed stops form one ordered physical block; stop identity is exchangeable only inside the block, block order is preserved, and one latent transport member persists across all blocks before it is marginalized

CBPE_formula.simulated_stop_event: E[s,r,m,b] in {0,1} is the frozen M1 reachability event for source s, historical route r, member m and completed stop b
CBPE_formula.simulated_block_count: K[s,r,m,j] = sum over the three stops b in source-update block j of E[s,r,m,b], so K is in {0,1,2,3}
CBPE_formula.observed_block_count: k_obs[r,j] is the analogous sum of the three measured-gas reachability events in block j
CBPE_formula.calibration_kernel: Q[a,b] = (1/2 + N[a,b]) / (2 + sum_c N[a,c]), where N[a,b] pools ordered member pairs m != m_prime over every House, source, frozen route and block with K[m]=a and K[m_prime]=b
CBPE_formula.calibration_interpretation: one global 4x4 source-, House- and seed-independent Dirichlet-Jeffreys posterior-predictive kernel; identity member pairs are prohibited and no measured observation, native PMFS posterior, truth or localization error enters Q
CBPE_formula.sequential_update: w_j(s,m) is proportional to w_(j-1)(s,m) Q[K[s,r,m,j], k_obs[r,j]]
CBPE_formula.batch_formula: q_CBPE,J(s) is proportional to q0(s) times (1/8) sum_m product_(j=1..J) Q[K[s,r,m,j], k_obs[r,j]]
CBPE_formula.coherence: the same m remains inside the product across all ordered blocks and is marginalized exactly once
CBPE_formula.partial_exchangeability: the three stop labels inside one block are discarded, but the ordered sequence of block counts is retained
CBPE_formula.no_double_count: M1 supplies the interventional predictive state K to this one CBPE likelihood; no separate M1 reach/count likelihood is multiplied into CBPE
CBPE_formula.geometry_prior: q0(s) is proportional to the frozen number of native free PMFS cells in carrier s

cell_interface.interpretation: the frozen V2 minimum-KL projection; CBPE replaces only the carrier marginal while independent native PMFS supplies its within-carrier conditional
cell_interface.zero_mass_policy: if q_CBPE(B)>0 and p_N(B)=0 for any B, the entire update returns native PMFS exactly

frozen_controls.GLOBAL_COUNT: the preserved V1 exchangeable count-only score over all visible stops
frozen_controls.BLOCK_ORDER_PERMUTE: apply one deterministic SHA256-domain-separated non-identity permutation to the observed completed-block order for J>=2; J=1 is necessarily identical
frozen_controls.INCOHERENT_PER_BLOCK: product over blocks of the member-averaged Q term, allowing member identity to switch between blocks
frozen_controls.SOURCE_LABEL_NULL: uniform unrestricted and equal-free-cell-count-stratified label permutations, with identity allowed inside individual strata
frozen_controls.IDENTITY_PROJECTION: using the native carrier marginal must reconstruct native PMFS cell mass exactly

truth_separation.stage_1: verify and read only the frozen bank, support, route geometry, update timing and measured_gas_ppm; write all 150 CBPE and control carrier posteriors and their SHA-256 manifest before reading a native PMFS posterior or case_result truth
truth_separation.stage_2: reload Stage 1 by externally supplied manifest hash; then read only byte-identical native PMFS posteriors and case_result files already preserved in the V1 summary
truth_separation.development_boundary: all seeds0..9 are opened development trajectories; PASS authorizes a runtime pilot, not a held-out paper claim

catastrophe_definition: method error is more than PMFS error plus 1.0 m and also greater than 1.5 times PMFS error
false_confident_collapse_definition: posterior variance is below 1.0 m^2 while official error exceeds 2.0 m
forbidden: changing M1, threshold, sensor constants, stop length, block size, member count, Q smoothing, source support, projection, endpoint or Gate after outcome read
House-, seed-, source- or error-conditioned Q
using true_gas_ppm, true source, localization error or a native PMFS posterior in Stage-1 evidence
adding a third scientific module, learned network, gate, blend, temperature or adaptive coefficient
selecting among multiple temporal formulas after this preregistration
starting runtime or closed loop after any hard-rule failure
downstream: Only a complete hard PASS permits one immutable runtime implementation followed by the requested H01/H02/H03 seeds1-3 paired 300-second OFF versus ON development pilot. A paper claim still requires untouched held-out seeds.
